implementation_identity: fingerprinted dirty source recorded in prepared_inputs.json; committed with this report
research_question: R-C / E2: total cost of acquiring information before choosing a federated strategy
scope: prepared-plan cost baseline integration on three already-exposed original questions

frozen_orders.role: three previously integration-exposed original queries; descriptive only
frozen_orders.cache_policy: Fresh owned databases, one source load, no query warmup; sequential queries and method order as listed. Paid acquisition necessarily warms its final execution.
frozen_orders.statistical_scope: Each method occupies each position across these three different queries, but no within-query counterbalancing or repetitions. No speedup or population inference.
frozen_orders.timing_scope: Prepared-plan decision-time baseline. Common compilation and fixture/service setup separately reported; paid method includes both acquisition runs, selection, final run, and intervening journal persistence.

limitations: Three exposed independent questions, one block; 15 plan outcomes are not 15 independent samples.
Whole SF0.1 loaded, but remaining 45 original query records are not_attempted.
Method wall includes synchronous rewriting of a growing full ledger and result rows. It is not a clean paper performance estimate.
Scheduler elapsed and client-call wall are separately retained; subtracting residual overhead does not repair the comparison.
No query warmup; order is only rotated across three different questions, with no within-question counterbalancing.
Paid acquisition warms its fresh final execution; measured costs are not unbiased predictions of alternate future executions.
Logical exchange bytes are not HTTP wire bytes. Common preparation/service/load costs are separately reported.
No model, P1 strategy bridge, A3 calibration, full-workload accuracy or scalability claim.
next_gate: Persist each action result once and use a small durable progress/selection index; measure persistence explicitly while charging online work.
